notes: 1.0.37: Reliability fix for the one-click update itself. In rare cases the app could get stuck after 'Closing to swap...' while updating - the updater kept retrying forever if the old program file was briefly still in use, instead of giving up. It now retries for up to a minute and then safely restores the previous version if the swap cannot complete, so an update can no longer hang. It also cleans up leftover update files on start and closes the window cleanly during an update. Everything from 1.0.36 is included (clearer messages when the app cannot pick a device; supplier and model names removed from the screens; servo shown as a direct RS485 connection).
